diagnostics.message: If an authoritative binding uses a custom role created by this module, the binding can be applied before that role exists and fail. Add an explicit dependency on the custom-role resource collection; the role value is supplied independently and there is no clean direct attribute reference that preserves its semantics.

If an additive IAM member is granted a custom role created by this module, it may be applied before that role exists and fail. Add a dependency on the custom-role resource collection; the role is provided as a string input, so there is no clean direct resource-attribute reference to express this ordering.
